extract_links_from_html_docs: extract all external and internal links from HTML documentation files in a directory
check_external_links: check external HTTP links for broken URLs by sending HEAD requests and verifying status codes
check_internal_links: check internal file links to verify that referenced HTML files actually exist on disk
list_doc_files: list all HTML documentation files recursively from a specified directory path
get_href_from_element: get the resolved href URL from an HTML anchor element handling relative and absolute paths
